funding.title: NVIDIA Academic Grant Program: Generative AI / Simulation & Modeling
funding.institution: NVIDIA Academic Grant Program, United Kingdom
description: Selected for the NVIDIA Academic Grant Program, which provides world-class computing resources (cloud, hardware, and/or software) to advance academic research in generative AI and simulation & modeling.

The grant supports research on cardiac whole-heart volumetric mesh reconstruction and generation based on Graph Gaussian Splatting (GGS), aiming to enhance the high-fidelity modeling of cardiac anatomical structures in simulation-ready format.
